product.name: Monoprice 1x8 20-Watt Guitar Combo Amplifier with Overdrive
product.description: This guitar amp employs a 20‑watt amplifier driving an 8‑inch, 4‑ohm speaker. It features both a solid clean and an overdrive tone with 86dB of gain. It has a line level output, which allows you to send the output to a recorder or mixing board. It also features a 3.5mm AUX IN jack, which allows you to plug in an mp3 player, so you can play along to your favorite tunes and practice at home. The 3.5mm headphone jack disables the speaker when in use, so you can play in almost complete silence. The Monoprice™ 20‑watt guitar combo is ideal for those looking for a solid, no‑frills, solid state combo that is good enough to be used at home and band practice.
